scope: Three moves in living_room_pedestal_three: the pedestal room photo edited with Muse Image to hold two more pedestals against the left wall (SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark spec; Spark called them side tables, 0.32 x 0.32 x 0.9 m, and the original pedestal a 0.85 m cabinet). All three are corrected to the carry tier (0.28 x 0.30 x 0.90 m, 3 kg). The outer side table goes next to the TV bench, the inner one (reachable only once the outer one is gone) to the front of the room, and the original pedestal to the spot the two left (0.975, 2.325; the first choice, 0.375, 2.325, failed: in run 20261102T005739 the pedestal sagged onto the floor mid-carry, identically in all three attempts). Destinations come from the viewer's feasibility grid with each earlier move applied; every approach and carry is 1.0-3.5 m, the range the policies were trained on (the second carry sits at 1.0 m; from the measured state of run 20261102T005739 the third approach is 1.07 m and its carry 1.17 m). Result: moves 0-1 completed (1.1 cm / 1.6 deg, 1.4 cm / 0.9 deg). The original pedestal, 0.23 m from the right wall, can only be gripped facing the wall, and every destination starts its carry with a turn-around there; it failed in every attempt (grounded twice, wall contact once) and the demo lists it as not moved.
